reviews.title: Good Item, Great Customer Service
reviews.comment: My main reason for buying this portable monitor is because of my previous experience with another Uperfect product. I have a 15.6 Qled 500 nits 1080p which is great and still running strong on my desktop set up. Very nice color production and brightness. Coming back to this particular product. It is big, light, easy to set up and still very portable, it just that it has 350 nits of brightness instead of 450 nits. Looking at the product description, it states that it has 450 nits of brightness and 120hz refresh rate. The refresh rate of 120hz is accurate but the brightness isn't. It only have 350 nits according to the manual included in the box. Comparing my older Uperfect Qled with 500 nits is brighter and color reproduction of qled vs. ips is a big difference.  I will use it for my ROG Ally and I need a better refresh rate than 60hz. It is still bright but not as bright and color reproduction of Uperfect Qled is very accurate. I contacted Uperfect customer service and have communication with Sophia. Great communications, she understood what was my issue with the product description not being accurate and suggested a compromise. Don't get me wrong, the monitor is very nice but what sold me is the brightness stated in the product description. She states that they will correct the product description soon for better description of the particular item. Uperfect stand with their product and that is why I choose them again for another portable monitor for my needs. After this very positive experience with Sophia, Uperfect customer service. I am looking forward of getting another product from them but will go with a Qled instead of IPS and maybe 2k resolution is in order, just waiting for the up coming prime days again. Thank you again Sophia of the Uperfect customer service. Photo: Uperfect 18.5 120hz 1080p 350 nits (left), Uperfect 15.6 60hz QLED 1080p 500 nits (right), LG 2k 240hz 600 nits (top)
reviews.author: Noel

reviews.title: UPerfect Monitor is the Perfect monitor for U and Me!
reviews.comment: I tested several products before trying out this UPERFECT 4K Portable Monitor.  I even ended up returning 3 of them because they weren't satisfactory (other monitors).  For me, quality is the most important for me.  I'm the type of person that enjoys good sound and good visuals.  As you can see in my setup, I have a gaming PC attached to a wide screen monitor, a 4k OLED monitor, and the 17.3" UPERFECT monitor at the base of the two other monitors.  I wanted something matte, something with Apple-like retina display, something bright and something large enough.  The screen size was perfect.  It was easy to set up and connected without any issues.  I did have one super minor issue with the power plug; it was making a slight humming noise but works perfectly fine.  Still, I'm a bit of a perfectionist.  I emailed the customer support that was listed on their card/website and they got right back to me and offered to ship me a new power plug.  Again, the monitor works perfectly!  I was so happy with the product, that I ordered a different UPERFECT 17.5" monitor for my office.  This company's products are great as well as their customer service.  I'll look here first to buy monitors before other brands!
reviews.author: J. Lee

reviews.title: Great portable monitor, top notch customer service
reviews.comment: This is a fantastic 1080p monitor that gives you options to power it using a single USB-C cable connected to your laptop to deliver power and data or use an additional USB-C cable through an outlet to solely deliver power.  If you opt for the former, the monitor will be dimmer since the single USB-C cable is providing power and data, so your best experience is definitely going to be when you have the second USB-C cable to deliver power. The monitor itself is lightweight so it's quite easy to carry it around (recommend you use a case) and even fit in a backpack along with your laptop to take it with you on the go.  The stand is built-in, so it gives you a quick and easy way to stand the monitor up for it to be used.  With all this, the build quality on this is very good. For the monitor performance, the color and brightness representation is great for a portable monitor and text was mostly easy to read, with the exceptions of some Webex meetings that involved very tiny text which is just the nature of a 1080p monitor for which their 4k monitors would address. There is a myriad of settings you can play around with whether that's contrast, brightness, enabling other modes to get the monitor to display to your preference. Also, I want to call out the quick responsive customer service.  I did have an intermittent issue that caused the screen to go black and flicker, so I reached out to them via email.  They responded within a few hours, and I was able to work with them on some basic troubleshooting.  After the basic troubleshooting didn't work out, they made it right very quickly by just offering to send me replacement and avoid all the remaining hoops of troubleshooting.  I got the replacement in just a couple of days, and it's been working great for me since. The product is great and the customer service is top notch, and I would have no hesitation buying from this brand again as they stand behind their products.
reviews.author: Christopher H.

reviews.title: UPERFECT Almost Perfect, However a Good Portable Monitor.
reviews.comment: I like this monitor for having a normal HDMI and not just a HDMI mini, it's slim and very portable! Thing is it doesn't have a case, I didn't know I could get a free case until the company messaged me about how I like my product, they pointed me in the direction to get a free case by emailing the customer support email on the back of the instructions of the product and gave me a PDF version in the message for my convenience which was nice, after emailing the support email, I got a response quickly about how to get my free case, which is to provide an address, and in addition to the free case as a separate offer in the same email, to be in their VIP club to try out other products. I declined the second offer as I have too much stuff already that I don't want to add to the pile, and expressed that I am only interested in the free case. There was no response after that until about two days and I was told that they had a weekend that they came back from. It was a little misleading as the page the email was listed on said it was 24hrs, (picture in this review), immediately they said they sent the free case that will come within two days and apologized for not responding sooner because of their weekend, so that was nice. I gave this product 4 stars because of the little bit of a hassle to get the free case, if you're going to have a free case, just include it in the product box! The other monitor I had and returned from a different company had a free case included and I liked that, I returned the other monitor because it only had HDMI mini and it advertised that it had HDMI not specifying mini only! The monitor from UPERFECT, when I first turned it on had a brighter spot on it near the top right, but quickly paned out as I played my game. (It was probably cases by the monitor before shipping being stored in a position not natural for the screen to handle before turning it on). The sound is fair, it does have a headphone jack, I just let the sound come from the monitor's speakers when playing my game. Over all I feel it's a good purchase and great for a gaming personal space!
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Great monitor, great size
reviews.comment: This is a great monitor, nice way to compliment my work environment and my wife's work environment, working hybrid this is great I can take the monitor to work where I don't have an office, just a desk and I can set this up as a secondary monitor at the office, and then when I get home, if I don't want to lug the monitor from the basement to the main floor, I can easily set this up. Depending on the laptop it can be powered by a single USB-C cable, but most of the time, this will need an external power. With the 2 included USB-C cables, I was able to easily power the monitor with my laptop, and if you don't have USB-C ports, you can use the included power adapter, which you would need anyway if you are using the mini HDMI to HDMI. I like the kickstand so much better than the smart screen covers that flip over backwards, most of the time those slip and the monitor falls. I do wish this had a standard HDMI port with the size of the monitor so you didn't have to carry a special cable with you. This has a great picture and it is a great travel addition.
reviews.author: Computer Doc
